invalid_reason: Game A phone (port 8886) returned 'Session closed' on every touch and gave no frames from play second 187.2; unresponsive for over 2 minutes, so the 540 s minimum was not reached. Game B was never played. Partial notes only.
label: Game A
nuance_found: Keeping the white distance mark inside the gold band by steering (too close is a ram that shoves you, too far is out of reach), holding couch only when the ring turns gold (too early costs 2 footing), and not couching under a storm cell (the bolt zaps your mast; the rival can be zapped the same way). Charge from lightning makes the next hit land harder. Mostly one obvious best line once learned.
audio: Looping regatta music that changed track between passes, thunder, wind gusts, lance crack and thud on hits, a victory sting and a defeat sting; fairly constant and satisfying.
furthest_progress: Third rival beaten (Pip, Bosun Barnacle after one loss, Doc Volta); mid-fight against Contessa Brisa (me 2 footing vs her 3) in tilt 2 when the session died. Best score 2,400. The Dock never visited.
control_trouble: Steer slider is very sensitive for my 0.5 s sampling, so I over and under corrected the gap marker several times. Holding couch early on the first rival was my timing.
best_moment: Rival zapped by their own storm cell, then a late couch finishing Barnacle.
worst_moment: Being rammed with no clear idea how to widen the gap fast enough, and bright lightning flashes that blank the screen while I am aiming.
verdict: Looks great and every hit feels big, with a win screen, spoils and a new rival every minute or so, which is exactly my kind of loop. The rules arrive in small tips so I understood quickly. The gap and storm cell rules take a few fights to get and I lost one fight to them. Session ended before I could give it a fair full length, so treat these numbers as partial.
